title: Study mode
description: A tutor mode for chats: the agent leads a learner to the answer with hints instead of giving it right away. A study viewer shows a course document next to the chat: select text or an area and ask about it; every question leaves a marker on its page.

modes.label: Study mode
modes.hintOn: Study mode is on: the agent asks what you tried and leads you with hints; the full solution comes after three hints and your own attempt. Click to turn off.
modes.hintOff: Turn on study mode: the agent becomes a tutor and leads you to the answer instead of giving it right away.
modes.newProjectHint: Study mode for new chats: the agent leads to the answer with hints instead of giving it right away

fileActions.label: Open in study viewer
fileActions.title: Read it next to a study chat: select text or an area and ask, or press WTF
